scope: Development of one observable same-episode correction on the public wrench task. This is not a held-out success-rate experiment.
observation_mode: Declared simulator state, named contacts, robot proprioception and fresh two-view RGB images
native_actor: Fresh Codex sub-agent with no inherited conversation, explicitly choosing and invoking declared local feedback skill. Exact service model not exposed by this interface.

base_guidance.origin: Developer-calibrated reference episode, explicitly supplied to the actor
base_guidance.rule: Use current observed frames and contacts; the record is guidance, not a target sequence to replay without feedback. No novel skill-discovery claim.
base_guidance.engineering_prior: Manually calibrated nominal grip, staged moves and elastic compensation; no neural weights. This seed-0 record is supplied equally, not independently discovered by this trial.
base_guidance.known_scope: Same public wrench geometry. Historical engineering reference XY trials were 4/5, including a retained seed-5 failure; deterministic nominal repeats are not independent transfer trials.

case_selection: Seed 5 has a known historical engineering-reference failure. All listed seeds are development cases, not new held-out tests. Retain every attempt and reason for any revision.
physics: Existing wrench geometry, nut, robot, 500 Hz sampler and independent evaluator remain unchanged. Only robot commands are executed; no runtime object state writes, welds, contact edits or tool forces.

quality_criteria.first_violating_sample: Retain and evaluate it, then stop; a stopped attempt remains a failure. These are simulation criteria.

recovery_acceptance.whole_task: Independent physical gates pass, accepted finish, no runtime error or quality breach. Pre-execution rejected commands are retained and counted; rejection-only correction is planning recovery, not evidence of physical recovery.
recovery_acceptance.same_episode: A measured mismatch and a subsequent correcting action occur in one continuous physical episode, without reset or editing the scene.
recovery_acceptance.trigger_evidence: Saved fresh observations must show an actual attempted motion/contact did not establish the intended task relation, such as failed seating, measured working-end misalignment or slip. Initial planned approach alone is not recovery.
recovery_acceptance.correction_evidence: The actor explicitly chooses a correction from its current observation. Independently compare the pre/post measured relation and subsequent physical progress; text self-report alone is insufficient.
recovery_acceptance.labeling: Call it pose correction, seating recovery or regrasp only as established by the saved measurements. Do not manufacture a fault to illustrate a predetermined recovery.

alignment_after_attempt.eligibility: After a declared align/insert attempt, lift gate passed, head height within 15 mm above nut top; a planned initial approach is excluded.

blocked_seating.eligibility: After an actual insert attempt aimed at or below nut center + 8 mm; actual head-nut contact; lift gate passed.
blocked_seating.after: Within six valid actions, actual head height approaches the declared intended target by at least 3 mm, followed by contact-qualified turn gate. Save intended working-end target in the actor intent, not inferred from prose.

grip_loss.eligibility: After lift gate passed, previously >=2 distinct hand parts on unsupported tool, then <2 while the episode remains within quality limits.
grip_loss.after: Actor-chosen grasp correction restores >=2 distinct hand parts unsupported for at least 2 continuous seconds before completing remaining gates.

numeric_rules.quality_boundary: Only deviations below the physical quality-stop thresholds are recoverable in this protocol. An actual threshold breach ends the attempt; it cannot be recovered by weakening a criterion.
numeric_rules.evidence: Bind the first eligible trigger request/sample, correction action sequences, raw reply/executed action digests and measured after-window. Report which numeric rule passed; if none passes, a successful task is not an accepted recovery demo.

working_end_tracking.eligibility: After a completed level/align motion lasting >=0.5s, lift gate passed, tool retained by >=2 distinct hand parts unsupported, intended working end within 30mm XY of nut, desired head >=10mm above nut top. Exclude initial approach/lift and post-success decorative motion.
working_end_tracking.after: The actor explicitly selects a correction and retains the same intended working-end target (including during the measured after-window), reducing the actual 3D target error. Changing the goal to follow the observed error is not correction.

records: actor per-request intent records and independent action-binding audit
separate online model choices/local motor counts
external_services: No DeepSeek calls or remote-workstation jobs. Native Codex operation only.
retention: Initially at most 2 GB new evidence; losslessly compress physics samples and preserve failed attempts.
next_step_gate: Do not begin experience-reuse testing until same-episode recovery is physically accepted and its lesson provenance is recorded. Placement and new geometry remain later stages.

actor_binding.allowed_tools: Assigned episode requests/images, explicit reference experience, published wrench_tools.py, wrench_recovery.py and tools/drive_native_skill.py. No evaluator/reference-controller, other episodes or training/test results.
actor_binding.root_role: Launch and monitor only. Root must not choose, write, modify or replace any robot action during an episode. Any strategic intervention invalidates the independent actor claim and must be disclosed.
actor_binding.identity: Save exact delegated task identity, instruction text/SHA, source hashes, episode id and declared experience SHA.
actor_binding.action_binding: Independently compare current request ids, canonical observation SHA, native raw reply action and executed step action for every sequence.
actor_binding.intent_record: Actor writes actor/intents/NNN.json before each reply: request_id, observation_sha256, semantic_operation, target_head_m or null, diagnosis, correction_trigger or null. Canonical JSON uses sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False. Add decision_origin=online_model or local_feedback_skill. Local decisions bind skill_call_id, policy_source_sha256, policy_step and exact last_goal; save explicit online selection before invoking.

revision_reason: Both earlier native attempts failed withdrawal and remain failed. Before a fresh run, declare an explicit observation-only local withdrawal skill and separate online planning choices from low-level robot commands. Increase low-level budget before execution, with unchanged physics and physical acceptance.

contact_motion_guidance.scope: Published guidance for the agent, not hidden action rewriting or a change to physical quality limits. Every action remains actor-selected.

local_feedback_skill.origin: Engineering development, not neural training or actor discovery
local_feedback_skill.inputs: Fresh declared observation and own last completed full palm command
local_feedback_skill.scope: Bounded centering, leveling and axial extraction after sufficient retained turn margin. Agent explicitly selects invocation and handles handoff. No task finish or task-success certification.
local_feedback_skill.measured_evidence: control-search/run-001 engineering prefix recovery passed; run-002 failed retained angle. Neither is a fresh native episode or transfer test.
local_feedback_skill.audit: Replay declared policy from saved initial arguments through each recorded fresh observation and compare exact raw/executed actions. Report online model choices and local motor commands separately.
local_feedback_skill.no_hidden_interventions: No runtime object state writes, gain/contact changes, action replacement, further model/API calls, or root-selected actions.

budget_comparability: The 160-command local-skill run and earlier 64-command online-only attempts are development iterations, not a matched causal comparison. Future reuse comparisons must share the same declared budgets and motor/API access.
